Meet the Puddle

The Duck holds the drink. The Puddle holds the snack.

One adorable bottle. Two everyday essentials. Slide off the silicone Puddle and it’s ready for snacks.

  • 2-in-1 silicone PuddleFood-safe sleeve + snack cup
  • Just the right size9 oz stainless steel, insulated
  • Flip-top straw lidSnaps securely closed
  • Spill-resistantBecause spills happen
  • Easy to cleanDishwasher-safe bottle & cap*
  • BPA-freeYour kids matter. We give a duck.
  • Little-hand friendlyLightweight + easy to grip
  • Made for little onesFor toddlers & preschoolers

*Bottle and cap are dishwasher safe. Hand-wash the silicone sleeve.

Good questions

Before you reserve.

Still curious? Write to us at team@ducksnpuddles.com — a real person answers.

How does the $1 reservation work?

You pay $1 to hold your spot before our Kickstarter campaign goes live. On launch day we email everyone who reserved a private link to a secret reward that only reservers can open.

Is the $1 refundable?

We’ll publish the full reservation terms, including refunds, right here before you pay — no small print surprises.

When will the bottles ship?

Bottles ship after the Kickstarter campaign ends. We’ll share a confirmed timeline before launch, and reservers get updates as production moves along.

What comes with each bottle?

Every Duck comes with its very own removable silicone Puddle — a 9 oz stainless steel insulated bottle with a flip-top straw lid, plus the sleeve that slides on and off.

How do I clean it?

The bottle and cap are dishwasher safe. Hand-wash the silicone sleeve.

What age is it for?

It’s designed for toddlers and preschoolers — lightweight, easy to grip, and sized for little hands.
